name: Word-by-word captions
summary: Speech shown as 1 to 3 large words at a time, with the word that is spoken now in a bright colour.
how: Show 1 to 3 words at a time at 72px to 110px.
Time each word to the audio within 2 frames.
Colour the active word and keep the rest white.
Add a 6px outline and pop each word in over 6 to 8 frames.

origin.note: Short video apps add auto captions, and makers restyle them as large animated words that follow the speech.

adoptions.via: Short video apps and editing tools add auto captions that makers restyle as animated words.
